notes: Reran all 78 firearm power ratings with the agreed manufacturer passives included in the audit.
Bastion ratings now include once-per-Long-Rest Action Surge burst value; Corvus includes conditional RAM Thief resource value.
ForgeLine ratings now account for Anchor advantage on turns where the wielder does not move; this materially raises its heavy/sniper line.
Helix ratings account for a full-mag recharge after a turn spent not firing, with the largest gain on weapons whose normal recharge cost is expensive.
Jade Arc ratings include a non-recursive full-damage kill-chain to a nearby enemy, weighted for the fact that it requires both a kill and an adjacent target.
Kurohane ratings include completely silent fire; Vektor ratings include full Cunning Action utility.
Weapon prices and hidden shop bands now follow the rerun ratings. Market stock patch 1.4.2 forces cached stock to rebuild against the new bands.
